guard: startup static reconciliation reports a failed sweep and re-drives the same durable exact terminal in process
why: The suite starts a real authenticated nats-server through serverConfig and an in-process Manager, then plants three durable orphan lifecycle rows.

The first mutation changes only the failed aggregate branch. The earliest named cell observes the completed first sweep after all three shipped terminal paths ran, so it reddens because failure became success-shaped reporting rather than because an earlier row short-circuited.

The second mutation removes only the retry scheduling call after the real middle-row terminal failed. Earlier aggregate, durable hold, and status cells still run; the named re-drive cell is the first one that requires a second exact terminal entry.

The shutdown mutations independently remove the accepted-sweep drain, the serial stop fence, and the start-task join. The real broker control gates the first terminal, calls stop, and names the first observable failure for each boundary.

mutations.name: report a failed reconciliation sweep with the clean-success aggregate
mutations.find: console.error(`! static reconcile completed: ${sweep.attempted} attempted, ${sweep.succeeded} succeeded, ${sweep.failed} failed; failed=${failed.join(",")}`);
mutations.replace: console.error(`✓ static reconcile completed: ${sweep.attempted} attempted, ${sweep.attempted} succeeded, 0 failed`);
mutations.expectRed: the first sweep is non-success and names the failed alias, phase, and disposition
mutations.cell: the first sweep is non-success and names the failed alias, phase, and disposition

mutations.name: do not schedule an in-process re-drive after the exact terminal fails
mutations.replace:
item.disposition = "retry-exhausted";
          item.remedy = "restart this manager for a fresh per-process retry budget";
mutations.expectRed: the same manager process re-drives the failed alias to retired
mutations.cell: the same manager process re-drives the failed alias to retired

mutations.name: stop returns while accepted startup reconciliation work is still running
mutations.expectRed: stop waits for an accepted startup reconciliation terminal
mutations.cell: stop waits for an accepted startup reconciliation terminal

mutations.name: a shutdown sweep starts the next planned alias after the accepted terminal drains
mutations.expectRed: the shutdown fence prevents the serial sweep from starting a later terminal
mutations.cell: the shutdown fence prevents the serial sweep from starting a later terminal

mutations.name: stop does not join startup after draining reconciliation
mutations.expectRed: startup cannot publish the manager service after stop completes
mutations.cell: startup cannot publish the manager service after stop completes
